sentences.text: ?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:8270
Court No. - 76
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 13850 of 2023

Applicant :- Rajkuma`r And 2 Others
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Avanish Kumar Srivastava

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Sri S.B. Singh, learned AGA-I apprised the Court that he has received the instructions, therefore,
the instant anticipatory bail application may be finally, disposed off.
2.

Heard Sri Avanish Kumar Srivastava, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri S.B. Singh, learned A.G.A.-I for the State-respondent.
3.

The present anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in Case Crime No. 420 of 2023, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 323, 504 IPC, Police Station Jait, District Mathura, with a prayer to enlarge him on anticipatory bail, till the conclusion of trial.

4. FIR of the present case was lodged against the applicant and according to the FIR, applicant no. 3 executed a sale deed in favour of the informant on 20.3.2023 and in spite of that he executed second sale deed with regard to the same property to Rania and Pappu.

Rajkumar And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41920563/
1 5.

entities.text: Rajkumar And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicants submitted that entire allegations made against the applicants are totally false and applicants did not commit any fraud.

6. He further submitted that there is no allegation against the applicant nos. 1 and 2 in the FIR and only allegation of fraud and cheating is against the applicant no. 3.
7.

He further submitted that number of sale deeds were executed by the applicant no. 3 in favour of the informant and in this regard some cheques were issued by the informant in favour of the applicant no. 3 but at the time of sale deeds all the cheques were taken back by the informant and without any consideration all the sale deeds were got executed by the informant in his favour.
8.

He further submitted that when applicant no. 3 came to know about the fraudulent intention of the informant then he gave a legal notice to him but inspite of service of notice, no reply was given by the informant.
9.
He further submitted that even an application under section 156(3) Cr.P.C. was moved by applicant no. 3 against the informant which was treated by the court concerned as criminal complaint.

10. He further submitted that applicant no. 3 also moved an application to the police against the informant and all these documents have been annexed alongwith the instant anticipatory bail application.

11. He further submitted that even a civil suit is pending with regard to the property in question which was filed in September, 2023 and FIR of the present case was lodged in the Month of October,
2023.
12. He further submitted that even otherwise present dispute appears to be civil dispute and informant can file a suit for cancellation of sale deed.
13. He further submitted that applicants are having no previous criminal history to their credit and police is trying to arrest them.
14. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail but could not dispute the arguments on facts advanced by learned counsel for the applicant.
15. I have heard learned counsel for both the sides and perused the record of the case.

16. Considering the fact that even before lodgement of the FIR of the present case number of applications have been moved by the applicant no. 3 against the informant of the case and even a civil suit with regard to the property in question is pending and present dispute appears to be civil dispute, in my view, applicant is entitled to be enlarged on anticipatory bail in this case, till conclusion of trial.

sentences.text: Accordingly, without expressing any opinion upon ultimate merits of the case either ways which may adversely affect the trial of the case, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court concerned shall have the liberty to cancel the bail granted to the applicants.

20. It is made clear that observations made in granting anticipatory bail to the applicants shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming their independent opinion based on the testimony of the witnesses.
